SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

This is a stocked fishery, not evidence that Amazon species are native to Thai rivers. Ask which tackle, bait and fish-handling assistance the venue supplies before buying an oversized freshwater outfit.

A stocked venue, not a native-species distribution claim

Confirm the venue’s current stock and equipment requirements directly. Fish listed for managed lakes must not be interpreted as naturally occurring in nearby rivers or the country’s wild waters.

Confirm the fishery’s equipment system

Ask the venue to specify the rod and rig approach, bait provision and fish-handling equipment. A travel kit should follow those venue requirements rather than a generic trophy-fish shopping bundle. Separate what is supplied from personal items needed for a long bank session.

What is established—and what is not

The named place or operator program is supported by the source statement above. The relevant page text was inspected. The environment, access and gear categories are editorial planning scenarios to confirm locally, not guaranteed availability or unrestricted fishing access.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Thailand

Thailand's official marine fisheries report states that recreational fishing is not regulated under its fisheries legislation. It therefore identifies no general marine recreational licence. Protected waters can still prohibit fishing, and freshwater access needs a separate check.

Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • Gillhams lake day ticket ↗
    Day visitors fishing the managed lake Reserve directly with Gillhams and sign the fishery rule book before fishing.

Rules for this water

  • Use micro-barbed hooks; treble hooks, barbless hooks and multi-hook rigs are prohibited.
  • No fly or lure fishing on the main lake; no live-fish bait.
  • Only staff may net fish; keep arapaima in the water.
  • Release all fish under staff supervision; do not take fish onto the bank.
  • Day-ticket hours are 08:00–18:00; obtain staff approval before you start.

Full Thailand licence guide ↗ · Checked November 2026.
